hints.title: Powers of Two Isolation
hints.text: Consider which integers cannot be formed as bitwise or sums of any subset.

hints.title: Single-Bit Representation
hints.text: To produce a power of two 2^k from a subset, at least one element must have the k-th bit set without having any other set bits.

hints.title: Smallest Missing Power
hints.text: If all powers of two 1, 2, 4, ..., 2^(k-1) are present, any integer up to 2^k - 1 can be expressed. The first missing power of two is the answer.

hints.title: Smallest Absent Power of Two Implementation

complexity.notes: Hashing the array elements takes O(n), followed by at most 32 lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all possible subset bitwise or results takes O(2^n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) set storage for O(1) membership checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the minimal impossible value must be a power of two.
